art_instructions: Show the cozy attic bedroom with sloped ceiling and exposed wooden beams, seen in warm lamplight with a small rounded moonlit window on the back wall. Use a high, wide view that shows the whole room at once. Along the back wall, place three small wooden beds with forest‑green blankets: Panda on the left bed, Koala on the middle bed, and Dinosaur on the right bed, all sleeping peacefully. Panda sleeps on her side with the blanket up to her chin and her wooden toy dinosaur peeking out from under one paw. Koala sleeps on her back with a leaf‑green scarf loosely draped around her neck; a shared nightstand between the left and middle beds holds a glowing acorn lantern and a short stack of picture books. Dinosaur sleeps on his back with his pale mint belly visible; his small red backpack rests on the floor beside his bed, and his breathing is suggested by gentle rise‑and‑fall cue lines. In the foreground center on a soft rug, Owl is just finishing a swift swoop and is landing lightly, wings half‑spread, head tilted, round amber eyes bright, and beak closed in a happy smile; her green scarf is visible. To show that she “eats all the mice,” only two or three tiny tan mouse silhouettes remain near her beak, dissolving into soft sparkle crumbs as they vanish; no intact mice are elsewhere on the floor (no blood or gore). Keep the warm palette: creamy walls, rich brown wood, and a few shelves with stuffed animals and trinkets on the side wall, with a stripe of moonlight across the floor.
